Method of Attack: Encrypts VMware ESXi virtual machine files using an encrypt.sh script that encrypts files in 1MB increments with a size_step to skip chunks of data in the first wave, and encrypts 50% of large files by alternating 1MB encrypted and 1MB skipped in the second wave
Uses ransomware to encrypt over 3,000 Internet-exposed VMware ESXi servers
Breaches devices using old VMware SLP vulnerabilities or unknown methods when SLP is disabled
Attack Vector: Exploitation of old VMware SLP vulnerabilities
Unknown breach methods when SLP is disabled
Indicators of Compromise: Encrypted virtual machine files with extensions .vmdk, .vmx, .vmxf, .vmsd, .vmsn, .vswp, .vmss, .nvram, .vmem
Ransom note without bitcoin addresses in second wave
Large amounts of encrypted data in ESXi virtual machine files
